premise: Hermit Crab's shell feels tight, so he goes house hunting: the bucket is too big, the sand castle too crumbly, and his own shell turns out just right for now.
inspiration: Goldilocks' three tries (folk tale), turned around: the right house was the one he had, and the bigger one can wait until he has grown.
lesson: What you have can be just right for now.
learning: A hermit crab lives in an empty shell it finds, and moves to a bigger one as it grows.

en-US.title: A Bigger House
en-US.text: {hermit-crab:enter} {hermit-crab:go to sand} Hermit Crab came scuttling over the sand, {hermit-crab:face sad} and he sighed. His striped shell felt a little bit tight. It was a borrowed shell, like every hermit crab's: an empty one he had found and moved into. And now he was growing. Time for a bigger one! [curious] So Hermit Crab went house hunting. First, {bucket:enter} the red bucket. {hermit-crab:go to bucket} He peeked inside. {bucket:wobble} It was enormous! [playfully] Hello… hello… hello… went the echo. {hermit-crab:face surprised} Far too big. Next, {castle:enter} the sand castle, with its little red flag. {hermit-crab:go to castle} He tried the door. {castle:shake} {sfx:crumble} Crumble, crumble. {hermit-crab:face sad} Far too sandy. [short pause] Then the spade in the bucket went {bucket:live} {sfx:scoop} scoop! Hermit Crab was so surprised {hermit-crab:live hold} that he tucked himself right inside his own shell. [softly] And inside… it was cosy. Just the right size, for today. {hermit-crab:live resume} He peeked out, {hermit-crab:face happy} and smiled. A bigger house could wait.

es-ES.title: Una casa más grande
es-ES.text: {hermit-crab:enter} {hermit-crab:go to sand} Cangrejo Ermitaño llegó correteando por la arena, {hermit-crab:face sad} y suspiró. Su concha de rayas le quedaba un poquito justa. Era una concha prestada, como las de todos los ermitaños: una vacía que había encontrado para vivir dentro. Y ahora estaba creciendo. ¡Tocaba buscar una más grande! [curious] Así que Ermitaño salió a buscar casa. Primero, {bucket:enter} el cubo rojo. {hermit-crab:go to bucket} Se asomó dentro. {bucket:wobble} ¡Era enorme! [playfully] Hola… hola… hola…, contestaba el eco. {hermit-crab:face surprised} Demasiado grande. Después, {castle:enter} el castillo de arena, con su banderita roja. {hermit-crab:go to castle} Probó la puerta. {castle:shake} {sfx:crumble} Cruc, cruc, se desmoronaba. {hermit-crab:face sad} Demasiado arenoso. [short pause] Entonces la pala del cubo hizo {bucket:live} {sfx:scoop} ¡zas! Ermitaño se sorprendió tanto {hermit-crab:live hold} que se metió del todo en su propia concha. [softly] Y dentro… se estaba de maravilla. Justo de su tamaño, por hoy. {hermit-crab:live resume} Se asomó, {hermit-crab:face happy} y sonrió. La casa grande podía esperar.

crumble.prompt: dry sand crumbling and trickling down, close up, realistic

scoop.prompt: a plastic spade scooping sand and tipping it into a plastic bucket, realistic
